text:
Noelle: Hey folks, Noelle here — joining from London today. Quick onboarding security Qs: 1) Ill be traveling in my first week and using a local eSIM. Do I need to do anything special for VPN or VPN split-tunnel settings? 2) Im on a short contract and won't be here to pick up a YubiKey — can you ship internationally / any customs gotchas? 3) I might need access to an air-gapped research dataset later — how does that work?
Maya (People Ops): Welcome Noelle :tada: Short answers: 1) Always use the company VPN on any untrusted network — enable full-tunnel for the duration of remote access to internal apps. 2) Ops can ship internationally but add extra lead time; tag @Ops Desk to confirm. 3) Air-gapped datasets require a dedicated company laptop + approved NDA + an access ticket from Security.
Kai (Security): Hi @Noelle — details: a) We disallow split-tunnel when accessing internal tooling; set the client to "full tunnel" in the OpenConnect profile. b) For travel, enable the VPN before opening Slack or email on public Wi‑Fi. c) International shipments: YubiKeys are fine but some countries label them as crypto devices — Ops will mark the package accordingly.
Noelle: Thanks — how do I force full-tunnel? I'm using the default OpenConnect profile on mac.
Kai (Security): On macOS with our VPN client: System tray > Redwood VPN > Profile settings > uncheck "Allow split tunneling". If you use CLI: ensure `--split-tunnel` is not set. Ping us if you can't find the toggle.
Noelle: Got it. About the air-gapped dataset — what qualifies as "air-gapped"? Is that a physical lab?
Kai (Security): Typically it's a physically isolated environment with no internet egress. Access requires a cleared company laptop (no personal apps), disk encryption, and an on-site sign-in. We'll require a short training and an access request describing purpose + retention plan. We'll also escrow any signing keys in our HSM.
Noelle: Oof ok — sounds like I'll need the company laptop then. Can Ops ship that to the UK?
Ops Desk: Hi @Noelle — we can ship a company laptop + YubiKey to UK addresses. Standard shipping 3–5 business days; expedited available for an extra cost. Please fill the hardware request form and choose "international" in the shipping dropdown. Include customs phone number if required.
Noelle: I filled the form and noted "international shipping + YubiKey". Anything else I should do meanwhile?
Maya (People Ops): Thanks! While you wait, complete the security modules on the onboarding checklist. If you're traveling, let us know travel dates so Security can flag temporary exemptions (e.g., delay phishing sim inclusion for the first week).
Noelle: Speaking of phishing sims — will I get flagged if I click something while on mobile abroad? Curious how strict the timing is.
security-bot: Automated message from security-bot: Phishing simulations are sent from simulation@redwood-security.test and include "[Redwood Simulation]" in the subject. New hires can request a short opt-out window (1 week) while traveling by asking People Ops. Report simulations using the in-client button to receive a micro-training email instead of a penalty. See https://intranet.redwood.com/security/phishing-sims for examples.
Noelle: Perfect, I'll ask for the one-week opt-out — traveling first 5 days. Also final q: for the full-tunnel VPN, will my personal browsing go through company network while active? Any privacy concerns?
Kai (Security): Full-tunnel sends all network traffic through the corporate egress while connected. We do not inspect personal browsing content, but we log egress metadata for security (destinations, bytes, timestamps). If you're concerned about sensitive personal browsing, use your phone's cellular data (not company laptop) or disconnect the VPN for personal traffic.
Noelle: Thanks — that helps. I'll wait for the laptop + yubikey and request the phishing opt-out. Appreciate the quick help!
Maya (People Ops): Welcome aboard :rocket: Ops, please confirm shipping ETA and customs note. Kai, we'll DM you travel dates for the phishing opt-out.
Ops Desk: Confirmed — received the hardware request. Standard international ship, ETA 4 business days; customs remark added. Tracking will be posted to your onboarding ticket.
Noelle: Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
